BROWSE PROVENANCE (a `browsed:<site>` / `browse-gap:<site>` event) is enforced DETERMINISTICALLY at the spec gate (uxDesignerBrowsedReason reads the persisted agent-log), NOT as a meta-channel output validator — the executor skips those (the resolved meta path is not the persisted log).
